title: Four-star general says MJ-12 is real

tellings.quote: four-star general who was asked about the documents. He said they're real or the Majestic 12 is real.

plain: An unnamed four-star general, asked about the Majestic 12 documents, papers describing a secret group of officials said to handle the UFO question, is said to have answered that they are real, or that Majestic 12 itself is real. The researcher UAPGerb relays this on Michels' show in 2025 without naming the general. If true, it would mean a secret UFO control group existed at the top of the US government.
